singlehero.mainMenu.multi: Multiplayer: hotseat on this computer, or play over the network. Same rules: one hero each.
singlehero.defeat.self: Your hero has fallen. In a Single Hero game your hero is your kingdom - you have been defeated.
singlehero.defeat.other: %s has lost their hero and is out of the game.
